instagram.name: Untold Granth | Ramayana Stories
instagram.bio:
🪔 रामायण की अनसुनी कहानियाँ, सीधे वाल्मीकि से
📜 Every reel shows its verse (Critical Edition)
🎧 Hindi narration · English subtitles
settings: Account type stays Professional → Creator; turn on “Display category label” (Edit profile → Profile display).
Edit profile → Links → Add external link → the YouTube link above, title “YouTube”.
Settings → Sharing and remixes: allow remixes of reels (more reach); turn off “Share to Facebook” unless you also run a Facebook Page.
After the first reel is live, pin it to the top of the grid (… → Pin to your profile).

youtube.name: Untold Granth
youtube.description:
रामायण की वो कहानियाँ जो अक्सर सुनाई नहीं जातीं, सीधे वाल्मीकि रामायण से।

Untold Granth tells short stories from the original texts, starting with the Valmiki Ramayana (Critical Edition). Every video shows the kanda, sarga and verse it comes from, so you can check it yourself. Hindi narration, English subtitles, hand-painted gouache art.

Series: Untold Ramayana | अनसुनी रामायण

Instagram: @untoldgranth.official
